authors: IC representative-selection workstream (core tier, design and preregistration)
question: On l = 2, depth-3, split-crater volcanoes at 24- and 28-bit p, does carrying a floor-curve ECDLP instance to the crater by verified 2-isogenies (transport charged) lower the charged index-calculus cost S below solving it on the floor, and does solving a crater instance on the best of 16 isomorphic models (chosen on calibration targets) lower S on held-out targets below the default model?

claims.text: Every counted run recovers the planted scalar; every transported generator is on its codomain with order r and every edge is additive (repsel verify).
Arm B costs less charged S than arm A at every band weight (0, 0.1, 1 GAE per native op), at 24-bit p.
claims.if_supported: floor-to-crater transport is a measured constant-factor IC improvement at 24-bit p (scope: these 12 classes, this factor base)
claims.if_not_supported: unresolved across the band, vanished within 3%, or inconclusive, per the decision rule

claims.if_supported: the floor deficit survives at 28-bit p net of transport

claims.text: Arm Csel costs less S than Cdef on held-out targets at every band weight, 24-bit p.
claims.if_supported: model selection is a measured per-target constant-factor improvement after a one-time selection whose cost is reported separately (break-even target count)
claims.if_not_supported: the v2 model effect does not survive held-out testing at this resolution

claims.text: Every IC arm is above matched rho (the distance remaining).
claims.if_supported: reported as the distance remaining, not as a gate
claims.if_not_supported: a parity crossing would be escalated to the breakthrough reviewers

claims.text: Nothing here is a security statement about any curve or about ECDLP at cryptographic sizes.

hypotheses.statement: l = 2 floor curves have a lower IC relation yield than their crater (v2 H1), so solving a floor instance on the crater, net of the charged transport, lowers S.
hypotheses.mechanism: the prime-abscissa factor base's relation yield is a property of the point set (pair46 03-floor-pullback); its cause on l = 2 floors is open (v2 mechanism contrasts)

predictions.minimum_effect: theta(B/A) at w = 0 in [0.93, 0.99] (v2 H5 1.045 => 0.957); the charged transport (1,034-2,125 native ops per run on the 14 v2 l=2 classes, repsel ascend) adds at most about 2.5% of S at w = 1

data_seen.measured: H1 l=2 IC yield floor/crater 0.942 [0.928, 0.956]; H5 IC S floor/crater 1.045 [1.023, 1.067]; model tau 7.2% (yield, all classes), S model tau 9.8% vs null p95 7.4% (l=2)
metric S, ic-mitm: vertical 1.0453, model tau_rel 0.0977 (null p95 0.0739), horizontal tau_rel 0.0197

predictions.minimum_effect: no prior at 28 bits; transport below 0.5% of S at w = 1 (derived: ops ~ log p, S*sqrt(r) ~ p)

hypotheses.statement: Isomorphic models of one crater curve differ in IC cost (v2 H4: model tau 7.2% yield, 9.8% S against a null p95 of 7.4%), so the model chosen on calibration targets is cheaper on held-out targets.
hypotheses.mechanism: which points have small abscissae changes under (x,y)->(u^2x,u^3y); whether that changes yield beyond sampling noise is the question

predictions.minimum_effect: held-out theta(Csel/Cdef) about 0.95 if the true model spread sigma_m is 5% (derived in PROTOCOL.md section 5); about 0.98 at sigma_m = 3%; 1.00 if the v2 effect was noise

data_seen.measured: H1 l=2 IC yield floor/crater 0.942 [0.928, 0.956]; H5 IC S floor/crater 1.045 [1.023, 1.067]; model tau 7.2% (yield, all classes), S model tau 9.8% vs null p95 7.4% (l=2)
metric S, ic-mitm: vertical 1.0453, model tau_rel 0.0977 (null p95 0.0739), horizontal tau_rel 0.0197

arms.description: rho.negation (ecbench arm rho-neg) on every workload; the matched rho of an instance is rho-neg on the instance's source curve (the floor curve for A/B/B0, crater model 0 for C)
floor instance solved on its floor curve (model as walked), ic-mitm
the same floor instance carried by three verified 2-isogenies to the crater (repsel ascend, every path-finding and point-map field operation charged) and solved there, ic-mitm
the same floor instance carried two steps to its sibling floor curve (same level, same transport machinery, charged) and solved there: separates re-modelling and transport from the level change
arm A re-measured under an independent measurement seed (stage aa): the IC noise floor of the B-vs-A statistic
crater instance on the crater curve's default model (model 0), held-out targets
the same crater instance moved by the isomorphism (x,y)->(u^2x,u^3y) to the model with the lowest mean calibration S among 16 (selection.json, frozen before any held-out run), 6 field ops charged
arm Cdef re-measured under an independent measurement seed (stage holdaa)
the selection rule applied to rho-neg calibration S (rho has no expected model effect); rho-neg measured on that model with held-out targets
rho.negation under a second arm name with the same seeds in every session: a determinism check (every pair must be identical) and the Iso Lab A/A admission arm
ic.pipeline with a 33-point base on the ctl workloads: planted relation-yield increase (33/32)^2 = 1.0635

bsgs.negation on the ctl workloads (A, B, B0 of one group, two targets): its cost depends only on the discrete log, so one distinct cost per (group, target) proves the transport and the instance pairing

positive.expected_detection: relation-yield ratio ic-mitm-plus1 / ic-mitm on the ctl workloads has a 95% CI excluding 1 (predicted 1.0635; v2 measured 1.062 [1.060, 1.064]); bsgs-neg has exactly one distinct cost per (tier, class, group, target); the analysis power controls (A/A data with X scaled by 0.96) reach p_iut < 0.0167

null_population.description: the selection procedure run on rho.negation, whose expected cost is invariant under isomorphism (v2 H3/H4: rho model effect not beyond its null, p = 0.08); and B0, the same carrier landing on the same level
null_population.generator: the same calibration and held-out sessions as arm C (rho-neg arm), and the ab-stage sessions (B0)
null_population.why_n: one unit per crater curve, the same units as H_C, so the null has the same resolution as the test

independent.name: procedure
levels: A: solve on the floor curve
B: carry to the crater (charged), solve there
B0: carry to the sibling floor curve (charged), solve there
Cdef: solve on the default crater model
Csel: move to the calibration-selected model (charged), solve there
Crho: move to the rho-selected model

factors.how: harness_drawn from the spec seed, per workload and round

comparisons.reason: the procedure is the factor under test; curve level, model and transport change together by construction, and C-MECH separates them

comparisons.threshold: descriptive: IC S / matched rho S at w = 0, 0.1, 1 (the distance remaining; 1.0 = parity)

transfer_obligations.obligation: every B and B0 workload is produced by repsel ascend from the floor curve's own coordinates; its edges are verified (image on codomain, order r, additivity) and its endpoint height recomputed by BFS (crater = 3, sibling = 0)
bsgs exactness and equal planted scalars across A/B/B0 of one group (check:transport) bind the transported instance to the floor instance

seed_derivation.note: design.json: target seeds (ab, ctl, cal, hold) and measurement seeds (main, aa, holdaa) per tier; analysis bootstrap/permutation seed 20261105; class-search seeds 2401.. and 2801.. in order. The masking nonce is drawn after the inputs freeze (external) and recorded in INPUTS.md.

instance_sampling.rule: classes by the volcano-rho search rule (design.json class_search); units are all floor groups (up to 8) and crater curves (up to 16) the export holds, in BFS order; targets by planted_shared from the frozen target seeds

blinding.how: repsel mask replaces every study-arm label with a code K01.. in the labels and comparisons; the analysis runs on codes; repsel unmask applies the key after analysis-masked.json is hashed. Numerical signatures (crater vs floor curves) can still reveal arms; the analysis has no free choices left to bias.

power.note: Primary family: H_B24, H_B28, H_C24 (Holm, smallest threshold 0.0167); each p is the max over the three weights (intersection-union). Sign-flip permutations 10,000: minimum one-sided p 1e-4 < 0.0167. Test-specific power (PROTOCOL.md section 5, derived from v2.1 variance: per-run CV of IC S within a curve-model 0.37-0.44, S model tau 9.8% raw, null p95 7.4%): H_B at w = 0 (effect 4.4% on the log scale) 0.90 if the curve-model spread is 6%, 0.67 if 10%; at the binding weight w = 1 the 24-bit power falls to about 0.45-0.55, which the decision rule reports as unresolved_across_band, not as vanished; H_B28 about 0.90 if the floor effect persists; H_C24 0.97 if sigma_m = 5%, 0.31 if 3%. instances = 96 floor groups per tier for H_B (8 x 12), 144 expected crater curves for H_C24.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: derived, not measured on study curves: EKS c8a online medians at 24/28 bits (taskq/deploy/eks-karpenter/validation/ic-size-sweep-20261026: IC 23.6 / 436 ms, rho 1.6 / 3.5 ms) and v2 L0 process walls (IC 0.45 s, rho 0.27 s); per-run estimates 24-bit IC 0.15 s, rho 0.10 s; 28-bit IC 0.60 s, rho 0.12 s; replay-all doubles each job; per job 60 s settle + ~300 s provisioning; about 144 job-hours over about 234 jobs

primary.name: charged S at weight w
primary.definition: (cost.total_gae + w * (unpriced native operations as ecbench band counts them + the arm's charged transport or isomorphism operations)) / sqrt(r), for w in {0, 0.1, 1}; every phase of the IC pipeline cold, setup included
primary.source: records.jsonl cost.total_gae, cost.unpriced + counters/phases.native, workload.curve_spec.r; labels extra_ops
primary.formula: theta = exp(mean over classes of ln(mean over units of X / mean over units of Y))

secondary.name: relation yield
secondary.definition: counters.relations_found / counters.targets_tried, ratio of sums within a unit

secondary.name: IC S over matched rho S
secondary.definition: theta(IC arm / rho-neg on the instance's source curve) at each weight
secondary.formula: theta(X = IC arm, Y = rho-neg on the source curve) at w

secondary.name: charged transport
secondary.definition: multiplications + inversions repsel ascend spends finding the path and mapping G and Q

secondary.name: selection precomputation
secondary.definition: sum of total_gae of the cal-stage ic-mitm runs of a crater curve; break-even targets = selection_gae / ((mean S_Cdef - mean S_Csel) * sqrt(r))

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: every job of inputs/jobs.tsv, then every hold/holdaa job of jobs-hold.tsv, then the analysis; no look at any IC cost before the last job is collected (04-collect checks hashes and gates only)
budget: USD 150 total (compute, launcher builds, retries); stop new launches when it or the daily allowance is exhausted or unknown and queue the rest

a job that fails admission (L2 gate, audit, replay, A/A) or is pre-empted is kept and re-submitted once as <name>-r2; a second failure, or a job over its deadline, is split in half by units (a labelled amendment, filed before its data) and the class is reported incomplete if that fails too
a wrong answer, a determinism mismatch or a failed check:transport stops all launches: instrument failure

invalidation_rules: a run not verified or not matching its planted scalar is excluded from S and counted per arm; any such IC run is an instrument investigation item
a record with a pinned calibration or an unpriced counter without a count makes the analysis refuse (no mispriced row)
a wall-clock value is descriptive only; no timing claim is made

decision_rule.text: For each primary hypothesis: invalid_measurement if a gate fails (determinism, check:transport for H_B, the A/A 95% CI at w = 0 excludes 1, the planted-yield CI includes 1, or for H_C the rho-selection negative control's CI excludes 1); supported_within_scope if Holm rejects at family alpha 0.05 on p_iut (the one-sided sign-flip p, max over w = 0, 0.1, 1); unresolved_across_band if p at w = 0 alone is below its Holm threshold but p_iut is not; vanished_within_margin if the power control passed and the 90% CI lower bound of theta at w = 0 exceeds 0.97 (gain below 3% with 95% confidence); inconclusive otherwise. The lead's discriminator: K2 or K3 supported and K4 supported => representative selection is a measured IC improvement (constant factor); K4 vanished_within_margin => the v2 model effect was sampling noise or selection artefact; both B tiers and C24 vanished => the lead closes as measured.
decision_rule.threshold: Holm over 3 at alpha 0.05 (0.0167, 0.025, 0.05); vanish margin 3%
decision_rule.statistic: theta = exp(mean_c ln(mean_u X / mean_u Y)), X and Y charged S at weight w
decision_rule.interval: hierarchical bootstrap (classes, units within class, runs within unit and arm), 4,000 resamples, seed 20261105; 95% and 90% percentile intervals
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: theta and 1 - theta in percent at each weight; gap to matched rho; selection break-even targets

graphs: theta by weight with 95% CI per hypothesis and tier (forest)
gap to matched rho per arm across the band
in-sample vs held-out selection gain per crater curve (winner's curse)

inadmissible: changing classes, units, targets, seeds, K, the held-out split, the selection rule, the charging, the weights, the margin or the correction after any measured IC value is seen
re-running a job because of its result; dropping a unit, class or run outside the invalidation rules
selecting on held-out targets or reporting in-sample (calibration) gains as the C result
omitting the transport or isomorphism charge, or reporting B at w = 0 alone as a ranking
reading C as a one-target cold improvement without its selection cost and break-even
any timing claim; any security statement
